# Draft:Paul Edwards

Paul Edwards MBE is a British entrepreneur, brewer, and drinks industry executive based in Busan, South Korea. He is a co-founder of Galmegi Brewing and the founder and chief executive officer of Gorilla Brewing Company. His work spans craft beer, hospitality, food and beverage operations, distilled spirits, and community and ecosystem development.
In 2025, Edwards was appointed a Member of the Order of the British Empire (MBE) in the New Year Honours (Overseas and International List) for services to international education, charity, and UK–South Korea relations.
Early life and education
Edwards was born in the United Kingdom. He studied geology, earning undergraduate and postgraduate degrees in structural geology, and later undertook doctoral research in the same field.
Career
Galmegi Brewing
In 2013, Edwards was a co-founder of Galmegi Brewing, one of the early modern craft breweries established in Busan following regulatory changes that enabled small-scale beer production in South Korea.
Gorilla Brewing Company
In 2015, Edwards co-founded Gorilla Brewing Company in Busan and later became its chief executive officer. Under his leadership, the company expanded into a multi-site operation comprising brewery facilities, taprooms, and hospitality venues. The company developed a portfolio of core and seasonal beers and established domestic distribution across South Korea, as well as export markets.
Better Gorilla
In 2025, Edwards established Better Gorilla, the food-and-beverage arm of Gorilla Brewing Company, created to consolidate and expand the company’s hospitality and dining concepts.
Spirits ventures
In 2024, Edwards launched Haechi Soju, a premium soju brand.
In 2026, he established 282 Distillery, a distilling venture focused on whisky and other distilled spirits.
Network Busan
In 2025, Edwards became involved in Network Busan, an initiative aimed at strengthening collaboration between entrepreneurs, startups, corporates, and institutions in the Busan region.
Governance and board roles
Edwards has served as a board member of the British Chamber of Commerce in Korea. He joined the board of governors of the International School of Busan in 2017 and has served as Chairman since 2019.
Honours
* Member of the Order of the British Empire (MBE) – 2025 New Year Honours (for services to international education, charity, and UK–South Korea relations)
